about_short_description.short_description: Million Marker is a service for people to measure personal exposure to everyday environmental chemicals in their body

product.name: Detect & Detox Test Kit
product.description: A mail-in urine test kit that measures personal exposure to 13 hormone-disrupting chemicals including BPA, phthalates, parabens, and oxybenzone.

product.name: Detect & Detox Test Kit: 2-Pack
product.description: A package including two Detect & Detox Test Kits for initial and follow-up testing to monitor changes in chemical exposures over time.

product.name: Million Marker Research Institute (MMRI)
product.description: A nonprofit organization conducting independent testing of personal care and household products to identify hidden toxic chemicals not listed on labels.

product.name: Approved Products List
product.description: A curated list of personal care, beauty, and household products vetted to be free from harmful chemicals such as BPA, phthalates, parabens, and oxybenzone.
